parameters.query:
SELECT 
  m.manuscript_summary,
  m.full_analysis_key_points,
  m.genre,
  m.title as manuscript_title,
  c.chapter_summary,
  c.title as current_chapter_title,
  prev_ch.chapter_summary as previous_chapter_summary,
  prev_ch.title as previous_chapter_title,
  next_ch.chapter_summary as next_chapter_summary,
  next_ch.title as next_chapter_title
FROM manuscripts m
LEFT JOIN chapters c 
  ON c.manuscript_id = m.id 
  AND c.chapter_number = {{ $('Extract Parameters').first().json.chapterNumber }}
LEFT JOIN chapters prev_ch
  ON prev_ch.manuscript_id = m.id
  AND prev_ch.chapter_number = {{ $('Extract Parameters').first().json.chapterNumber }} - 1
LEFT JOIN chapters next_ch
  ON next_ch.manuscript_id = m.id
  AND next_ch.chapter_number = {{ $('Extract Parameters').first().json.chapterNumber }} + 1
WHERE m.id = '{{ $('Extract Parameters').first().json.manuscriptId }}'
UPDATE public.as_journeys SET status = 'received', received_at = NOW() WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid RETURNING id, status
UPDATE public.as_journeys SET status = 'ready', completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid RETURNING id, status
UPDATE public.as_journeys SET status = 'failed', completed_at = NOW(), terminal_reason = $2 WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid RETURNING id, status
